explanation: NTILE(5) makes five groups of equal size. With three quarters of the customers on 1 order, those customers fill the first three fifths and most of the fourth, so identical customers get F = 1, 2, 3 or 4 depending on the tie order. That is why Voltmarkt scores frequency with fixed bands on the number of orders. NTILE neither skips ties nor gives them a shared score.
